BEFORE THE TAMIL NADU ELECTRICITY REGULATORY COMMISSION 
CHENNAI 
Order No. 5 of 2026, dated 26-05-2026 
____________________________________________________________ 
Present :   Thiru R. Manivannan   .... Chairman 
Thiru K. Venkatesan   .... Member 
In the matter of : Additional Tariff Subsidy Order for FY 2026-27 due
to   increase   of   free   electricity   of   total   200   units   bimonthly   to
domestic   consumers   who   consumes   electricity   upto   500   units
bimonthly by the Government of Tamil Nadu. 
______________________________________________________ 
The Government of Tamil Nadu (GoTN), vide G.O.(Ms) No.50 dated
10-05-2026,   has issued policy directions   under sub - section (1) of section 
108 of the Electricity Act, 2003, for   provision   of free electricity of total 200

2 
units bimonthly   to   domestic   consumers   with   consumption upto   500   units
bimonthly with effect from 10-05-2026 and those who consume electricity
more than 500 units bimonthly, the existing tariff structure would continue
including free electricity of 100 units bimonthly. 
2)   The   Government   of   Tamil   Nadu   (GoTN),   vide   letter
No.2800/D3/2026 dated 10-05-2026 has also issued commitment letter to
provide subsidy u/s 65 of the Electricity Act, 2003 in order to compensate
the   revenue   shortfall   to   Tamil   Nadu   Power   Distribution   Corporation
Ltd.,(TNPDCL). 
3)   TNPDCL,   in   their   letter   dated   18-05-2026   have   stated   that   the
Government   of   Tamil   Nadu   for   compliance   with   the   aforesaid   policy
directives has allotted to provide Rs.1730 Crores/annum as additional tariff
subsidy to TNPDCL.   As the policy directive is being effected from 10-05-
2026,   the   provisional   tariff   subsidy   has   been   worked   out   as   Rs.1545.14
Crores   for   the   period   from   10-05-2026   to   31-03-2027.   The   details   of
provisional tariff subsidy for the period from 10-05-2026 to 31-03-2027 i.e
326 days have been worked out as follows:
